title: Remove CLEAN27 for Create Item from Item No. setup fields
summary: Removes the CLEAN27-guarded code for the Create Item from Item No. fields in the Sales & Receivables Setup and Purchases & Payables Setup tables and pages, across the W1 and localization layers. The related helper code in the LibrarySales and LibraryPurchase test libraries is also removed.
key_points: Removes CLEAN27 code for the Create Item from Item No. fields in tables 311 and 312
Removes the matching controls from the Sales & Receivables Setup and Purchases & Payables Setup pages
Removes the related helpers from the LibrarySales and LibraryPurchase test codeunits
Applied in W1 and many country layers
